verdict.rationale: Dots is an agent product, so asking whether you can grant it narrowly scoped credentials is a fair question. However, the evidence shows no capability to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials for it. The closest items are adjacent controls: inherited ChatGPT app permissions (e.g. read-only email access), action-handling rules, and a private form for entering website logins. None of these are issuable API credentials, and the runtime probe found no dots-specific public API surface.
